about.title: We're building the guide we wish existed.
about.subtitle: Homefront Journal is a home-services resource for people who just want a straight answer.
about.lead: We're not a directory. We're not a lead-gen site. We're a small team of operators and editors who got tired of watching homeowners get burned by bad advice, bad information, and bad contractors.
about.whyBody1: The internet is full of home-services content that's either outdated, padded with filler, or written to sell you something. Google "how often to service your pool" and you'll get five different answers and three thinly-disguised ads.
about.whyBody2: We built Homefront to be the opposite of that. Short, honest guides. Real numbers. No fluff. And when you need a pro, a way to find one we'd trust in our own homes.
about.quote: The best home-services resource is the one you don't have to fact-check.
about.howBody: Everything on Homefront is written by people who've actually worked in home services — not by content farms. When we publish a cost range, it's from real quotes. When we say a sign means trouble, it's because we've seen it go wrong.
about.value1Body: Guides are written to inform, not to sell. If you never hire anyone, we've still done our job.
about.value2Body: Real ranges, published openly. No "call us for a quote" games on the pages that don't need them.
about.value3Body: Every pro we connect you with meets a standard we'd apply to our own homes.
about.value4Body: We're built for the DFW metroplex, not a national template. City-specific costs, region-specific advice.
about.whoBody: Homefront is produced by a small team of home services operators and editors. We also operate our own service brands — Poolburg and Supremacy Service — which you can read about on the Our Brands page. Some of the pros we connect you with are part of our own network; others are trusted partners. Either way, you get the same standard.
about.ctaSub: Get matched with a vetted local pro in under a minute.

ourBrands.title: Who we work with.
ourBrands.subtitle: Homefront Journal is a homeowner resource and referral platform. Here's exactly who we connect you with — and why.
ourBrands.intro: We're transparent about how our network works. Some of the pros we connect you with are part of our own family of companies. Others are trusted partners we've worked with for years. Every single one meets the same vetting standard.
ourBrands.poolburgBody: Poolburg is our DFW-focused pool services brand. CPO-certified technicians, licensed and insured in Texas, specializing in weekly service, equipment repair, and pool remodeling across the metroplex.
ourBrands.supremacyBody: Supremacy Service is our full-service field brand. From plumbing and HVAC to pest control, electrical, holiday lighting, and landscape — Supremacy covers the rest of your property with the same standard we apply to pools.
ourBrands.partnersBody: Beyond our own brands, we work with a select group of independent local pros. They meet the same vetting standard: licensed, insured, and reviewed by our team. We don't list them publicly — we route to them the same way we route to our own brands, based on what you need and where you are.
ourBrands.trustBody: Whether the pro is part of our own family of companies or an independent partner, you get the same vetting, the same transparency, and the same quality bar. That's the whole point of Homefront.
ourBrands.ctaSub: Get matched with a vetted local pro in under a minute.
